context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 腹痛/蒸し暑い/暖炉/オムツ/饅頭/日陰/雨水/プロポーズ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、腹痛、絶対、ある?ママ、絶対、心配だわ
lines.en: Sho, honey — do you really have a stomach-ache? Mama's genuinely worried about you.
lines.style: Warm, searching tone with a note of anxiety underneath. Leans in slightly. Speaks with the careful clarity of a mother checking in — not interrogating, just needing to know. Her concern is real but gently held.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、今日は、絶対、すごく、絶対、蒸し暑い、絶対、ね
lines.en: Mom — today's so humid and hot, isn't it?
lines.style: Bright observation delivered with quiet certainty. No performance, just a simple fact he's noticed. There's a slight wry edge — like he knows exactly why she was asking. Small, genuine tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 冬は、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちの、絶対、暖炉、絶対、温かいわよね、翔くん
lines.en: In winter, Grandpa's house feels so warm with the fireplace going, doesn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic drift. Speaking partly to herself, partly to him. Soft pacing. Like she's remembering something pleasant while watching him in this moment. Wistful but present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの妹、絶対、オムツ、絶対、もうすぐ、絶対、卒業するんでしょ?本気で
lines.en: Mom — my little sister's almost done with diapers, right? She's going to stop needing them soon?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, seeking confirmation. Not anxious — just the wondering tone of an older sibling noticing change. Clear, direct question. He's processing something he's observed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、お土産の、絶対、饅頭、絶対、もらったわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandma sent home those sweet manju pastries for us, didn't she, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, animated recollection. A little brighter than her previous tone — she's pleased. Speaking with the satisfaction of remembering a small kindness. Gentle affection in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お庭の、本気で、絶対、日陰、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お昼寝、絶対、したいよ、ママ
lines.en: I want to take a nap in the garden shade, Mom. Can I?
lines.style: Soft, almost drowsy request. Not demanding — just a gentle preference stated simply. The kind of quiet certainty only a child can have about what they want. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 梅雨の、本気で、絶対、雨水、絶対、お庭の花壇に、絶対、溜まってるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: The rainwater's pooling up in the flower beds from this rainy season, Sho. We'll need to watch that.
lines.style: Observant, practical tone with a note of gentle concern. She's thinking aloud, noticing details. Not fussing — just the quiet awareness of someone tending to things. Steady and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ママに、絶対、プロポーズ、絶対、した時、絶対、どんなだった?本気で
lines.en: Mom — when Dad proposed to you, what was it like? What happened?
lines.style: Direct, eager curiosity. He's genuinely asking — wanting to understand something tender about his parents. No shyness. Clear and focused attention, the way he gets when something matters to him.
